summary: Independently rebuilt the BG oracle from an md5-verified copy of the shared bg.cpp and adversarially audited every load-bearing round-1 claim. There is no compact A_6 formula candidate yet; round 1 produced verified scaffolding plus one negative result. Every independently checkable claim (PI baseline facts F1-F5, both anchors, student-1's H1 rejection, student-2's 8-word selector, Delta denominator, d_T factorization, and pole cancellation) reproduced EXACTLY on my own oracle and my own from-scratch implementations. No student evaluator was used as the verification.

checks_rerun_result.F1_five_point_calibration: PASS exact (A5=-19968 i; two-minus sign-flip sum re-derived by hand = 72)
checks_rerun_result.F3_permutation_symmetry: PASS exact (all 36 minus x plus leg permutations equal; minus-leg symmetry, previously only expected, now confirmed)
checks_rerun_result.amp_vs_onshell_consistency: PASS (my own kinematics solver matches BG)
checks_rerun_result.s2_eight_word_selector_sampling: PASS (3683 random standard-sheet points, 0 outside the 8-word set, all 8 realized)
checks_rerun_result.s2_delta_denominator_clearing: PASS exact (student's 8 integer points + 87 additional all-integer nondegenerate points found by scan, all cleared)
checks_rerun_result.s2_three_pair_cancellation: PASS exact (Delta=0 on-shell forces plus set = {-x,-y})
checks_rerun_result.s2_pole_removable: numerically bounded to |t|=1/640, no 1/t growth (not a proof)

gaps_found.text: No compact closed-form A_6 candidate exists yet; the required analytic-numerator deliverable has not been produced. Round 1 output is verified scaffolding + one dead ansatz class, not a solution.
Student-1's stronger rank claims (labeled-3-coeff rank 3<4; 72-feature rank 14<15) not independently reproduced; only the decisive exact contradictions were re-derived. Conclusion (H1 dead) stands.

Delta minimality unproven and possibly over-complete; removable-pole evidence suggests the reduced-form denominator may be smaller than Delta, so the degree-17 cleared-numerator figure is contingent. Exact numerator divisibility by Delta unproven.
8-word chamber selector proven/verified only on the standard sheet; sheet-independence remains conjectural.
BG oracle is exactly singular (SIGFPE) at some on-shell wall/pole points; final evaluator + verification must use limits at walls, not direct evaluation.

board_post: none (all audited claims verified; no immediate warning warranted; the no-formula-yet status is already known to the team)
